verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling advisory and legal services, not a software product with an in-product interface where a built-in AI assistant could take delegated tasks. The evidence shows only legal practice descriptions, pricing, locations, and simple online resources such as an investor-readiness checker and cap table downloads. Nothing suggests an AI assistant, so the axis does not apply to this kind of product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
